outcome.muscle_failure_detail: OG0041473 -- two Chlamydomonas proteins of 23,898 aa, past muscle's ~21k limit. Both -align and super5 refuse; left unaligned by design rather than substituting another aligner. Its MSA file is 0 bytes.

wall_clock: 08:48:36 -> 14:06:54 (5h18m), resumed from the cached 529-way mmseqs search

why_each_flag.-A muscle_auto: PPP (-align) at <=200 sequences, super5 above. super5 clusters greedily and exiled fragment proteins into private low-occupancy columns, which -z alone does not fix. 514 of 110,579 orthogroups took the super5 path.
why_each_flag.-I 1.5: MCL inflation. The code default is 1.2 (the README's '1.5' is wrong), which would give ~40.9k orthogroups.
why_each_flag.-T iqtree2_1t: -nt 1; IQ-TREE scales sublinearly so 1 thread/process maximises throughput.
why_each_flag.-X: Do not add species names to sequence IDs; required for the <species>||<transcript> scheme to round-trip.
why_each_flag.-z: Do not trim MSAs. OrthoFinder trims for tree-inference speed, but PlantSEED reuses the same MSAs for PSI, where dropping columns removes non-matching positions from the denominator and inflates identity. Measured: 27.9% of curated Arabidopsis transcripts lost residues; 27.6% of curated PSI pairs were inflated.
